config.design: Capture last-token attention outputs at all18 layers for eligible families. Discovery: patch donor write bidirectionally at every layer; identity, paired +/- norm-matched Gaussian controls, same-answer discovery donor where available. Select maximum mean signed donor task-margin effect, lowest-layer tie break. Freeze selection before validation. Evaluate all other cohorts at chosen site, including failed native gates as diagnostic only.
config.alignment: Last-token attention output swap, same final input token required; absolute positions and prompt lengths may differ. This is a whole-write causal assay, not identification of an input subspace or natural latent intervention.
config.holdouts: sequence_copy and spatial_inverse are predeclared whole-task training holdouts among eligible tasks. Their site diagnostics are permitted, but no examples from them may enter featurizer training.
config.controls: Gaussian seed fixed by pair/source/layer/recipient, identical +/- direction, norm equal to donor delta. Same-answer donor chosen by intersecting intended token groups within discovery, different prompt and pair, first available index; absence disclosed. No per-example correctness filtering.
config.metrics: Signed task-margin change, output KL(patch||native recipient), KL(native donor||patch) as context-confounded diagnostic. Select on donor task effect only; report corruption specificity separately.
config.bus_semantics: Patch attention output y only; preserve the native v1 bus object. The current layer MLP and all downstream layers react to the edit. Compare hook implementation to independent manual path on nontrivial patches including layer0.
config.limits: Only4 discovery pairs/family and reused development vocabulary. Whole-write localization does not establish semantic unit or general layer4 relevance.

selection.rule: Maximum mean donor-directed margin on discovery only; no validation access.
